title: Sanctions/PEP list manifest v1
description: Describes one published sanctions/PEP list snapshot (EDGE_DATA_RESIDENCY_CONTRACT.md section 6.4). GET /api/v1/edge/sanctions/list, HSE-1 context 'hokeka.sanctions.list', signed with the Control Plane Ed25519 key, sealed to the node's X25519 key, inside the channel replay envelope; ETag is the quoted listHash. The entries travel in separately fetched chunks. listHash is the SHA-256 hex of the UTF-8 text made of one line '<index>:<sha256>:<entryCount>\n' per chunk in index order, and equals sanctions.listHash of the Edge config that announced this snapshot.

format.description: Chunk payload format: gzip-compressed JSON lines, one sanctions-list-entry per line, base64 in the chunk document.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the chunk's uncompressed JSON-lines bytes.

bytes.description: Size of the gzip-compressed payload (before base64), for progress and sizing only.
